definition:
SELECT r.source_term_id,
    r.target_term_id,
    r.relationship_type,
    source.term_name AS source_name,
    source.term_type AS source_type,
    source.slug AS source_slug,
    target.term_name AS target_name,
    target.term_type AS target_type,
    target.slug AS target_slug
   FROM ontology_relationships r
     JOIN ontology_terms source ON source.id = r.source_term_id
     JOIN ontology_terms target ON target.id = r.target_term_id;
